purpose: Compact 3D terrain visualization grids aligned to E5 Sentinel-2 patch centers; visualization only — does not generate new contract features or alter features_earth.parquet *_src.
primary_version: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 DGED (COP-DEM_GLO-30-DGED; AWS COG / Planetary Computer cop-dem-glo-30, TanDEM-X 2021-04-22; ESA Product Handbook GEO.2018-1988-2)
fallback_version: NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001 (fallback only where Copernicus GLO-30 tile N39E044 is absent)
glo30_sigma_z_rel_ref: Airbus / ESA Copernicus DEM Product Handbook (2022, GEO.2018-1988-2, Sec 4.2: LE90 < 2.0 m)
vertical_reference: EGM2008 orthometric height for Copernicus_DEM_GLO-30 (39 sites); EGM96 orthometric height for NASADEM_HGT_v001 fallback (earth_agri_dogubayazit_flow)
e5_alignment: Grid center (x_center_m, y_center_m) matches the exact geometric center of the 512x512 (5120x5120 m) Sentinel-2 L2A visual patch in data/processed/earth_atlas/<site_id>.webp; grid edges correspond to exact E5 pixels [145:367, 145:367] (UV [0.283203125, 0.716796875]).
